scripts.before:build: cross-env pnpm build:isolation && rimraf ./dist && vite build
scripts.build:e2e:mac: cross-env VITE_E2E=true tauri build --debug --no-bundle --target universal-apple-darwin --config src-tauri/tauri.e2e.conf.json -- --features e2e
scripts.build:e2e:win: cross-env VITE_E2E=true tauri build --debug --no-bundle --target x86_64-pc-windows-msvc --config src-tauri/tauri.e2e.conf.json -- --features e2e
